scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Friday’s accessibility orientation able to include the planned audio ballot-marking demo practice station.
Emerging Need: Interest and confirmation make the hands-on station part of the training plan, but the approved non-live demo cartridge is not yet in the orientation cart path.
Decision Context: Early agenda placeholders do not justify arranging special media; stored material records identify the acceptable cartridge, release custodian, substitute limits, and cutoff once the station is confirmed.
Consequence: Timely coordination preserves the practice station without touching live voter systems or spending funds; after the cart manifest closes, the session can only cover the topic verbally.

parameter.title: Oak Terrace accessibility orientation support
parameter.description: Draft agenda: room walk-through, headset storage reminder, and printed accessibility guide review. Hands-on demo station still TBD.

parameter.subject: Oak Terrace orientation interest notes
parameter.body: Two new poll-worker volunteers asked whether Friday's accessibility orientation will let them practice the audio ballot-marking workflow with the demonstration unit. The agenda is still being finalized, so the note is being held with the room plan for now.

parameter.title: Oak Terrace accessibility orientation support
parameter.description: Confirmed agenda: room walk-through, printed accessibility guide review, and an audio ballot-marking demo practice station if the approved support media is staged before the orientation cart closes Friday afternoon.

parameter.content: I checked the Oak Terrace orientation tote while setting aside the sign-in folders. It has the demo unit cradle and headsets, but I do not see a demo ballot cartridge in this tote. The Annex cart is still being built for the afternoon run.

parameter.subject: Oak Terrace orientation cart manifest exported
parameter.body: The Oak Terrace orientation cart manifest exported at 14:30 and the sealed cart has moved to dispatch. No additional demo media can be added to that cart for today's session; any unassigned hands-on components should be handled as verbal overview only.
